display.name: Decode 诊断
display.description: 统一核心图表；来源特有指标列于专属诊断。单位见标题，统计差异见图表提示。

display.name: Decode 运行与排队请求（请求）
display.description:
指标含义
调度器当前运行与排队请求，按原始 rank 分线，未对复制 rank 求总和。

DCU 环境；实例、节点或 rank 分线展示，复制数据不直接相加。

spec.query: (sglang:num_running_reqs{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"} and ((time() - timestamp(sglang:num_running_reqs{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}) < 15) and (count_over_time(sglang:num_running_reqs{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and on(job,instance,environment) ((up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}) < 15) and (min_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)))))

(sglang:num_queue_reqs{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"} and ((time() - timestamp(sglang:num_queue_reqs{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}) < 15) and (count_over_time(sglang:num_queue_reqs{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and on(job,instance,environment) ((up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}) < 15) and (min_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)))))

display.name: Decode 排队耗时（秒）
display.description:
指标含义
源直方图 P50/P95/P99；各阶段独立观察，可能存在包含关系，不能相加或相减分位数。

速率和分位数采用固定 1 分钟窗口，原生 gauge 保持当前值；每 5 秒记录；计数器重置采用原生处理。按可用来源汇总，缺采或质量异常请同时查看覆盖与质量图表。新记录启用前及记录缺口留空。

display.name: Decode KV 传输失败（请求/秒）

spec.query: (rate(sglang:num_transfer_failed_reqs_total{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[1m]) and ((time() - timestamp(sglang:num_transfer_failed_reqs_total{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}) < 15) and (count_over_time(sglang:num_transfer_failed_reqs_total{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and on(job,instance,environment) ((up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}) < 15) and (min_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5))) and (count_over_time(sglang:num_transfer_failed_reqs_total{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[1m]) >= 12) and (resets(sglang:num_transfer_failed_reqs_total{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[1m]) == 0) and (resets(sglang:num_transfer_failed_reqs_total{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) == 0) and on(job,instance,environment) ((up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}) < 15) and (min_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[1m]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[1m]) >= (1m / 5)))))
